lockup.summary: Directors and executive officers agreed not to sell for six months after the offering closes, unless the lead underwriter agrees. The company itself agreed not to sell shares for four months.

what: It is a clinical-stage drug company developing BIV201, a treatment for fluid buildup and other serious complications of advanced liver cirrhosis.
proceeds: It expects net proceeds of about $17.0 million. It will use them for general running costs, including a quarterly support fee to BioVie, and the rest to fund a Phase 3 trial of BIV201.
